scene_prompt: Modern neighborhood market walkway. A shopper already carrying a large basket full of eggs and ripe fruit greedily stretches far down to grab a single tiny plain coin on pavement, eyes fixed eagerly on small coin, ignoring tipped basket on other arm. Many eggs and soft fruit spill from basket and break or get squashed on ground, far greater loss than coin gained. Child beside him points anxiously at falling groceries. Show the causal moment: one hand pinches tiny coin just above ground, other arm tilts basket unwisely, eggs visibly falling under gravity; no traffic danger, sharp glass or injury. Emphasize unnecessary eagerness for tiny extra gain causing large loss. Person not portrayed as hungry poor or needing coin. Natural exactly two arms and five fingers, basket handle weight credible, grounded feet, realistic eggs shells safe. Landscape 3:2 graphite watercolor colored-pencil ivory paper; no readable text labels brands letters numbers logos watermarks.
